title: Cross-language model test vectors
description: One file per model. The Dart and pytest suites both iterate over `cases`; neither side owns the expectations.

model.description: Class name, the same on both sides.

dart.description: Repo-relative path of the Dart model.

python.description: Repo-relative path of the Python model.

description.description: Becomes the test name on both sides. Unique within the file.

data.description: The JSON the model is decoded from.

expected.description: Valid cases only: the model's JSON after decoding. Defaults to `data`.

error_field.description: Invalid cases only: the one wire field that breaks. Each invalid case breaks exactly one field.
